A.name: reported-prerequisite-cancel-replan
A.rule: Cancel abort is a no-op; Save rejects one temporary route while preserving the 5M to 4M parent intent and rebuilding a complete chain.

B.name: alternate-main-target-after-fresh-occupancy
B.rule: Fresh actual state makes the original target unavailable after the modal opens; a complete deterministic alternate main target must be visible and historically linked.

C.name: no-safe-replacement
C.rule: No complete original-target or alternate-target plan exists, so the result is scoped diagnostic-only without operative projection.

D.name: independent-drag-after-replacement
D.rule: A real independent graphical order remains stageable after successful prerequisite cancellation replanning.

E.name: independent-drag-after-diagnostic

positivePhysicalPreconditions.rule: 12S contains E-INDEPENDENT while VS, 12N and VN are physically empty, no route resource is reserved and the production route validator accepts 12S to VN.

negativePhysicalConflict.rule: The original VS and 12N occupancy is retained as an explicit unsafe 12S to VN rejection case with zero operative projection.

E.rule: A scoped diagnostic cannot poison the graphical receiver for an independent vehicle whose physical route has first been proven valid.

F.name: repeated-prerequisite-cancellation
F.rule: Two rejected prerequisite strategies never loop back to an earlier target or chain.

G.name: fresh-actual-during-replan
G.rule: The replacement planner reads fresh actual state and cannot select a newly occupied temporary target.

H.name: main-cancellation-unchanged
H.rule: Cancelling a main card remains main cancellation and does not enter prerequisite replanning.

I.name: delete-card-unchanged
I.rule: Delete remains a separate canDelete path and creates no prerequisite rejection context.
